teacherNotes: Teacher-approved exact L437 handoff. 修 ㄒㄧㄡ. L436 owned by Production C. S03 preparing school-funded repair, S04 repairing a broken existing toy, S05 focused friendly competition. No text/number image exceptions. Only current plus previous five targets count toward coverage.

approvedSentences.text: 爸爸正在修補破掉的木門。
approvedSentences.spokenText: 爸爸正在修補破掉的木門
approvedSentences.imageNotes: 家中木門下方有一塊破損，固定主角爸爸蹲在門邊，把合適大小的木片固定在破洞處。主角女孩站在旁邊看，工具放在爸爸身側。要看得出正在修補門板，不是換門鎖或重新油漆。爸爸與女孩沿用正式家庭角色。
approvedSentences.imagePrompt: Create L437-S01 one square 1:1 children's course illustration, no collage. References: contact sheet row1 full L058 style-only, row2 refined treatment, row3 family; second image exact father/girl identity. Match rich fine pencil and watercolor texture, warm golden natural light and detailed clean Taiwan home. Father short tousled dark-brown hair, blue open shirt over white tee, tan trousers; girl short bob pink hairclip, pink cardigan, navy skirt, pink shoes, age/proportions exactly anchors. Scene: father kneels beside a wooden home door, repairing a clearly broken section low in the door panel. He holds a fitted wood patch partly over jagged hole and fixes it with handheld screwdriver. Girl stands nearby watching, tools neatly beside father. Show actual damaged panel edges and patch, not lock repair, not painting. Natural hands, safe margins, meaning readable on phone. No mother/other people. No text, numbers, logos, labels, bubbles, watermarks. Avoid flat cartoon, simple wash, anime, tiny chibi toddlers or redesign. Match references closely.

approvedSentences.text: 這張圖要修改，你有什麼想法？
approvedSentences.spokenText: 這張圖要修改你有什麼想法
approvedSentences.imageNotes: 主角女孩和固定「你」小男孩坐在畫畫桌旁。桌上的公園圖已畫好樹木、小路，仍有一塊空白；女孩指著圖詢問男孩，男孩指向空白處提出想法。呈現兩人討論怎麼修改，不把畫畫成明顯錯誤、只有唯一答案的考題。「你」沿用短微亂黑髮、天藍上衣、綠短褲的固定男孩，不可畫成小光。
approvedSentences.imagePrompt: Generate L437-S02 a single square 1:1 children's picture-book course illustration. Reference contact sheet: top row full L058 style-only, middle row refined style/child proportions, bottom row family girl. Match rich detailed pencil-and-watercolor textures, warm natural light, clean detailed Taiwan home, same expressive faces and ages. Scene: fixed protagonist preschool girl short dark bob pink clip pink cardigan cream shirt navy skirt sits at art table with fixed 你 boy, slightly tousled short black hair, sky-blue shirt, green shorts, blue shoes; orange bag hangs on his chair. No glasses; boy is NOT Xiaoguang and NOT striped-shirt older brother. On table one large drawing of a park with established trees and a curving footpath and some blank space. Girl points to existing drawing asking for ideas, boy thoughtfully points to blank area suggesting a possible addition. Both engaged in discussion. Drawing is attractive and open-ended, no obvious error or single right answer. Composition shows both faces, pointing hands and drawing clearly; safe margins. No words, text, numbers, correction symbols, speech bubbles, logos or watermark. No generic cartoon, simplified watercolor, anime, chibi. Maintain identity and rich warm course style.

approvedSentences.text: 學校願意補助修理舊球場。
approvedSentences.spokenText: 學校願意補助修理舊球場
approvedSentences.imageNotes: 學校舊球場邊，地面可見裂縫與磨損。學校行政人員把補助款信封交給固定老師，旁邊的維修人員帶著工具查看破損處。行政人員、老師、維修人員外貌要有區別；款項不交給孩子。呈現準備修繕，球場尚未修好。信封不露鈔票或文件上的文字數字。
approvedSentences.imagePrompt: Create L437-S03 single square 1:1 image. Reference1 contact sheet L058 top row style-only and refined middle row; reference2 exact teacher identity. Match detailed warm pencil-and-watercolor children's picture book with fine textured shading, rich clean setting, natural faces and adult proportions. Scene: edge of an OLD school sports court, clearly cracked and worn surface in foreground, school buildings behind. Exactly three distinct adults: school administrator an older man with receding graying hair, rectangular glasses, pale shirt and charcoal vest hands a plain CLOSED funding envelope to the recurring woman teacher (dark low ponytail, sage green cardigan cream shirt, same reference identity, not mother). Beside them a stockier repair worker wearing navy cap and ochre work shirt, toolbox, kneels studying the cracked surface. Clear envelope transfer between administrator and teacher, not to worker or child. They are preparing future repair; damage still present, no already repaired court. No children or money bills. No writing or numerals on envelope, papers, walls, clothes, court; court boundary lines okay. Phone readable with safe margins. No labels, speech bubbles, logos, watermark. Preserve L058/refined treatment, not flat cartoon, simple wash, anime or photo.

approvedSentences.text: 大家互助合作，把小船修好。
approvedSentences.spokenText: 大家互助合作把小船修好
approvedSentences.imageNotes: 主角爸爸、主角女孩和主角哥哥圍在工作桌旁，修理一艘木製玩具帆船。船身完好，但桅杆鬆脫：哥哥扶穩船身，女孩遞上掉下來的帆，爸爸將桅杆裝回固定。三人分工清楚，呈現正在修理，不是從頭組裝新船。使用固定家庭角色，哥哥不可替換成「你」或小光。
approvedSentences.imagePrompt: Create L437-S04 single square 1:1 course story illustration. Contact sheet full L058 top row is style-only, middle row refined style; second image is EXACT recurring family identity. Same warm rich detailed fine pencil and watercolor illustration texture, natural faces and proportions. Exactly three family members around home worktable: father matching anchor tousled dark hair blue open shirt white tee tan trousers; little girl matching anchor bob pink clip pink cardigan navy skirt; older brother matching anchor short dark hair blue-and-white striped long-sleeve shirt dark trousers, visibly older/taller than girl. Brother is NOT skyblue/green 你 boy, no glasses/Xiaoguang. Repairing one previously used wooden TOY sailboat: hull intact with subtle wear; mast had come loose. Brother steadies the existing intact hull with both hands, father carefully fits and secures the loose mast into its socket, girl hands father the detached cloth triangular sail. Show these distinct cooperative actions, visible loose sail in girl's hands and mast in father's hands. No second boat, no kits, no piles of new assembly parts. Simple hand tools on side. Warm Taiwan home, clean detailed background, central boat repair large enough on phone, safe margins. No text/numbers/logos/bubbles/watermarks. No anime, flat cartoon, generic simple watercolor or redesigned cast.

approvedSentences.text: 兩隊互不相讓，都想拿第一。
approvedSentences.spokenText: 兩隊互不相讓都想拿第一
approvedSentences.imageNotes: 學校球場上，兩隊 generic 同學穿不同顏色球衣進行足球賽，雙方積極追球、攔截，表情專注。畫面是努力比賽，不是生氣推擠。這是正常可用的球場，不沿用 S03 待修球場的破損狀態。不需要獎牌、名次、球衣號碼或記分板文字。
approvedSentences.imagePrompt: Generate L437-S05 one square 1:1 course story illustration. Contact sheet top row L058 style-only and refined middle-row examples: warm natural light, rich fine pencil-and-watercolor linework, detailed clean environment, bright warm colors, expressive natural preschool/early-primary proportions. Scene: school football/soccer match on normal smooth usable sports court, NO cracks/damage. Two teams of generic schoolchildren in distinct plain coral-red jerseys and teal-green jerseys; about 3 visible players per team, girls and boys with varied hair and faces, no recurring main characters cloned. Both teams actively try to win, running toward ONE soccer ball and making a focused fair interception. Central two opposing players contest ball with feet, keeping hands to themselves; faces determined and focused, no angry pushing/fighting. Other teammates run to support. School and trees, a plain goal in background. No scoreboard, medals, trophies, numbers or writing on uniforms. Meaningful action and all necessary feet/ball safely within frame. No text, labels, logos, watermark, speech bubbles. No flat cartoon, anime, generic simple watercolor, photorealism or chibi proportions. Preserve established course style.
